slides.title: Speculating about the present
slides.subtitle: must, might, can't + be / -ing
goals: Make guesses about people and situations.

items.en: They must be on holiday. They're wearing swimsuits.
She might be waiting for someone.
He can't be a teacher. He looks about 15.
It looks like a wedding. / They seem happy.

items.q: The lights are off. They ___ be at home.
He's wearing a uniform. He ___ be a nurse.
I'm not sure. She ___ be his sister.

items.t: She ___ be very rich. She has three houses! (seguro)
They ___ be studying. The library is open. (posible)
